content.text: Webb rescues Burt, who is injured and near death on Cro’ Nest after an eagle chase and blizzard; the party carries him home. The family rejoices, while Amy increasingly trusts Webb, though Burt’s ardent courtship unsettles her. Spring arrives through birds, flowers, floods, fishing, farming, Easter worship, and an eagle captured on a mountain ledge. The Cliffords study soil, crops, birds, hawks, seeds, bees, roses, and seasonal change. Amy visits West Point with Burt, later observes Webb’s rose garden, and turns instinctively to him when he kills a snake threatening catbirds’ nest. Webb realizes he loves Amy and leaves for the city to regain control, returning during a West Point excursion and helping with haying. Throughout, nature’s cycles mirror the household’s emotional growth.
